save_numpy_arrays_to_ten_file: save a list of numpy arrays to a .ten binary file using the tenbin save function
load_numpy_arrays_from_ten_file: load numpy arrays from a .ten binary file using the tenbin load function
encode_numpy_arrays_to_buffer: encode a list of numpy arrays into a single binary byte buffer using encode_buffer
decode_buffer_to_numpy_arrays: decode a binary byte buffer back into a list of numpy arrays using decode_buffer
write_numpy_arrays_to_stream: write a list of numpy arrays to a binary stream with magic bytes and padding using write
